newsitem.title: DENMARK: Buoyant Danish shares set to hit more record highs.
newsitem.headline: Buoyant Danish shares set to hit more record highs.

text.p: Danish share prices climbed in early trade on Tuesday in a positive market despite the overnight Dow fall, with dealers seeing the top-20 KFX index hitting new peaks.
"The market undertone is basically positive so Monday's profit-taking on Wall Street should not prevent us from continuing upwards," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.32 point to 178.57 at 0740 GMT, having closed 0.49 point higher on Monday at a new record closing high.
